title: Ascendance of a Bookworm ~I'll do anything to become a librarian!~ Part 3 Let's spread books through the duchy!

titleEnglish: Ascendance of a Bookworm ~I'll do anything to become a librarian!~ Part 3 Let's spread books through the duchy!
titleNative: 本好きの下剋上~司書になるためには手段を選んでいられません~ 第三部 「領地に本を広げよう!」
synonyms: Honzuki no Gekokujou ~Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen~ Dai 3-bu 「Ryouchi ni Hon o Hirogeyou!」
synopsis: Manga adaptation of Part 3 of Honzuki no Gekokujou . To protect those she cares about from danger, Myne abandons the life she knows to become Rozemyne, the archduke’s mana-rich adopted daughter. But her passion for books hasn’t changed, nor does she hesitate to charge into another strange new world. In this biblio-fantasy by bookworms, for bookworms, the detailed setting continues to expand—and so too does the book-making industry! (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
titleRomaji: Okiraku Ryoushu no Tanoshii Ryouchi Bouei: Seisan-kei Majutsu de Na mo na Kimura wo Saikyou no Jousai Toshi ni
titleEnglish: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
titleNative: お気楽領主の楽しい領地防衛 ～生産系魔術で名もなき村を最強の城塞都市に～
synopsis: Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he’s considered a child prodigy…until he displays the “Production Magic” skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace. With only his personal maid, the memories of his past life, and his “worthless” magic, can Van improve the fortunes of this little village—and himself? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Märchen Girl Runs!!!
titleNative: メルヘン・ガール・ランズ!!!
synopsis: The story begins with Snow White, who fell asleep after eating a poisonous apple, waking up in modern-day Japan. After wandering the streets of the city, she arrives at Kabukicho, where she is called out to by a woman named Karen. Karen also seems to come from a fairy tale world, just like Snow White, and the two hit it off. However, one day, after going to meet the "prince," Karen's behavior becomes strange... In order to return to her original world, Snow White unites with "princesses" from other worlds, such as Cinderella, and struggles to activate magic. (Source: Natalie, translated)
